(()=>{const upper=document.querySelector('[aria-label="3D view controls"]'),lower=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Model navigation"]');if(!upper||!lower||lower.querySelectorAll('button').length!==5)throw Error('Toolbar split missing');if(upper.getBoundingClientRect().top>=lower.getBoundingClientRect().top)throw Error('Toolbar order');for(const b of lower.querySelectorAll('button')){const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.height<44||r.top<0||r.bottom>innerHeight||r.left<0||r.right>innerWidth)throw Error('Bottom control clipped')}if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Viewport overflow');return {parts:document.querySelector('.building-canvas canvas')?.dataset.meshCount,top:upper.textContent,bottom:lower.textContent,viewport:[innerWidth,innerHeight]}})()
